meta.name: one-to-one-prep
meta.description: Generates a structured prep document for monthly 1-on-1 meetings with direct reports. Aggregates context from previous meeting notes and task tracker data, tracks action item status, and generates prioritized discussion topics with motivation and wellbeing questions. Use when preparing for one-on-one meetings, 1:1 check-ins, manager-employee meetings, one-to-one prep, 1-on-1 agenda generation, preparing for regular reports meetings. Russian triggers: подготовь 1-on-1, prep для ван-он-вана, готовлюсь к 1:1, подготовка к встрече с сотрудником, сгенерируй агенду для 1-on-1, подготовь встречу один на один.
